scope: Owner-scoped Agent/parent-job selection, signed-quote Cloud delegation draft, native Wallet approval/hold, Broker proof, explicit Cloud approval, and same-ID recovery; paid production dispatch disabled
implemented: The authenticated Rockstar device-home response includes only the account owner's active/review Zema jobs, reduced to ID, title, status, revision, and update time, and only when Zema access is allowed.

Android Shell API v13 displays eligible parent jobs and requires a current verified quote, unchanged prompt, prompt-disclosure consent, and a parent budget at least as high as the quote cap before saving a draft.

The Broker re-fetches the owner's connected Agent directory, re-verifies the signed quote against the exact Agent identity and prompt, recomputes the quote-bound native authorization digest, and checks the Cloud response for matching delegation, parent job, idempotency key, message, quote and approval digest.

The Shell persists only parent job ID, idempotency key, and prompt hash before POST. If the result is uncertain, the UI offers a read-only GET using those same values and never repeats the create request.
The draft response must remain awaiting_approval. Saving a draft creates no Wallet hold, Broker execution proof, Agent dispatch, Provider execution or billing. Paid dispatch remains disabled.
AIDL v18 exposes distinct proposal and confirm calls for a native Wallet reservation. Device credential confirmation issues the exact approval; only the confirm call creates the local hold.
Native Broker rechecks the exact HELD hold and signed quote before signing/uploading a proof; this proof upload does not itself dispatch the task.
A different explicit user action approves Cloud execution only after exact hold, active proof and owner-scoped readback. Uncertain response is not replayed and fences the hold until same-ID readback.
The Cloud stable delegation UUID is used as the pre-dispatch local task ID and is bound to the provider remote task only by the signed usage receipt.
